notes.title: Early Access v1.0.1 Hotfix
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Gang's ultimate now auto-destroys itself if Gang dies while it is active. 
[*]Shaper's Ultimate, Black Hole, now also silences the enemies for its duration.
[*]Fixed a bug where Clockwork Beats wasn't going through with its win condition
[*]Fixed a bug where Roboto's ultimate didn't work under some arenas
[*]Fixed Dr.Torre's name display plate being misspelled

[/list]
